run_parallel_compose_benchmark: run the parallel compose benchmark to time gtn.compose forward and backward passes on batches of linear graphs
run_parallel_forward_score_benchmark: run the parallel forward_score benchmark to time gtn.forward_score forward and backward passes on batches of graphs
run_parallel_indexed_func_benchmark: run the parallel indexed function benchmark to time gtn.parallel_for execution of Python functions across a batch
review_time_compose: review the time_compose function which benchmarks parallel graph composition using gtn.compose with forward and backward passes
review_time_forward_score: review the time_forward_score function which benchmarks parallel forward scoring using gtn.forward_score with forward and backward passes
